claim_boundary: The obstruction blocks only basis expansion followed by loss of factor-block membership. It does not refute grouped-subspace FPT construction, partition-aware adaptations, NAND3+NEQ, or resolve P versus NP.
exact_theorem: For every d>=1, two identical leaves GF(2)^d have grouped subspace-arrangement branch-width d, while the ordinary represented matroid obtained from two copied canonical bases after forgetting their two blocks has branch-width exactly 1.
offset_rule: Every factor leaf retains its distinguished beta functional independently of the normal-space decomposition skeleton.
